resources.desc: A lightweight approach to removing Google web service dependency. Ungoogled-chromium is Google Chromium, sans dependency on Google web services.

resources.name: Firefox
resources.desc: Open Source, independent browser. It needs some hardening and tweaking to achieve great privacy.

resources.name: LibreWolf
resources.desc: Privacy-focused Firefox fork.

resources.name: Mullvad Browser
resources.desc: Browser with the privacy and security implications of the Tor Browser, without the use of the Tor network.

resources.name: Zen Browser
resources.desc: Firefox-based browser with enhanced tracking protection on by default and a focus on calm, uncluttered browsing. MPL-2.0 licensed.

resources.name: Floorp
resources.desc: Firefox fork with telemetry disabled and extra customization, built with privacy in mind. Open source, MPL-2.0 licensed.

resources.name: uBlock Origin
resources.desc: Free, open-source ad content blocker. Easy on CPU and memory.

resources.name: LibRedirect
resources.desc: A simple web extension that redirects Twitter, YouTube, Google Maps and many more requests to privacy friendly alternatives. Former Privacy Redirect is no longer maintained, LibRedirect is a maintained fork.

resources.name: Privacy Badger
resources.desc: Browser extension from the EFF that learns to block trackers as you browse. Open source, GPL-3.0 licensed.

resources.name: ClearURLs
resources.desc: Browser extension that automatically strips tracking parameters from links and URLs. Open source, LGPL-3.0 licensed.

resources.name: Single File
resources.desc: Save a faithful copy of an entire web page in a single HTML file so you can use it offline.

resources.name: xBrowserSync
resources.desc: Browser syncing as it should be: secure, anonymous and free!

resources.name: GlobaLeaks
resources.desc: Self-hostable whistleblowing platform for organisations, newsrooms and activists, replacing hosted reporting portals. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

resources.name: SecureDrop
resources.desc: Self-hosted submission system that lets newsrooms receive documents from anonymous sources over Tor, replacing email and cloud uploads. Open source (AGPL-3.0).
